data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, **1Password Business is my top recommendation**\. It offers the best balance of security, ease of use, team sharing, administrative controls, and scalability.

The right choice depends on whether you're a 3-person startup, a 10–20-person business, or a larger team with IT and compliance requirements.

## Best password managers for small teams

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password Business**

(Best overall experience)

- Excellent shared vaults and permissions
- Easy for nontechnical employees
- Admin controls, security reports and access management
- Good employee onboarding and offboarding
  
  Business: approximately \$8.99/user/month annually. Teams Starter Pack: \$24.95/month for up to 10 users.
  
  [1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden Teams**

(Best value)

- Open-source foundation
- Shared collections and secure credential sharing
- Admin controls and audit logs
- Great value for budget-conscious businesses
  
  Approximately \$4/user/month annually.
  
  [Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper Business**

- Strong administrative controls
- Shared team folders
- Detailed access policies
- Good fit for compliance-conscious businesses
  
  Business pricing varies by plan.
  
  [Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

- Privacy-focused approach
- Passwords and secure notes
- Shared vault capabilities
- Worth considering for privacy-conscious teams
  
  [Proton Pass business plans](https://proton.me/business/pass)

These are approximate published prices, not quotes; check current plan limits before purchasing. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[geekchamp.com](https://geekchamp.com/best-password-managers-for-small-business-teams-with-shared-access-controls/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[itsecureops.com](https://itsecureops.com/guides/small-business-password-managers/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to 1Password and Bitwarden\:

| Consideration | 1Password | Bitwarden |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Ease of use | Excellent | Very good |
| Team sharing | Excellent | Excellent |
| Admin controls | Excellent | Very good |
| Budget | Higher | Lower |
| Technical flexibility | Good | Excellent |


For a small business without a dedicated IT department, I'd lean toward 1Password. If keeping costs down is important, Bitwarden is an excellent alternative.

## A few questions to narrow it down

I can give you a much more specific recommendation if I know\:

**1\. How many people are on your team?**

I'll use those answers to recommend the best fit rather than simply the most popular product.
